title: Take-up of SkillsFuture AI courses and support for PMEs
asked: Asked for the take-up rate of AI-related skills training courses supported by SkillsFuture and whether the Ministry has targets on the number of workers, especially PMEs, who should go for such upskilling.
response: Dr Janil Puthucheary said there are around 1,600 AI-related courses supported by SkillsFuture Singapore, with 137,000 training places taken up by more than 105,000 individuals last year. He said the Ministry does not set targets specifically on the number of workers who go for AI training, and that the Government supports upskilling through course fee subsidies and SkillsFuture Credit. In response to supplementary questions, he said the Ministry will continue to review how it signposts, directs and curates courses, is working with industry to map tasks to courses, and will review subsidies and funding arrangements.

key_points.point: There are around 1,600 AI-related courses supported by SkillsFuture Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: there are around 1,600 artificial intelligence (AI)-related courses supported by SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG)

key_points.point: Last year, 137,000 training places were taken up by more than 105,000 individuals.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: 137,000 training places taken up by more than 105,000 individuals last year

key_points.point: The Ministry does not set targets specifically on the number of workers who go for AI training.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: we do not set targets specifically on the number of workers who go for AI training

key_points.point: Government support includes substantial course fee subsidies and SkillsFuture Credit to offset out-of-pocket costs.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: substantial course fee subsidies as well as the SkillsFuture Credit to offset out-of-pocket costs

key_points.point: The Ministry will continue to review how it signposts, directs and curates courses.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: we will continue to review how we signpost, direct and curate courses

key_points.point: It is working with industry to develop a list of tasks and map them to courses.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We are working with the industry to look to see how we develop the list of tasks and map them to the courses

key_points.point: It is trying to improve signposting through websites, online offerings and counselling.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We are trying to improve our signposting, both in terms of the websites, the online offerings as well as the counselling that people get

key_points.point: It will continue to review support through subsidies and funding arrangements.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: we will continue to review how we support Singaporeans through the variety of subsidies and funding arrangements

key_points.point: It works with economic agencies and industry to understand how individuals who go through training are subsequently deployed and use their skills.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: we work closely with the economic agencies and the industry to understand how individuals who go through training then subsequently are deployed and use their skills

key_points.point: Tracking deployment specifically for AI may be a little bit harder.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: to say that we do so specifically for AI, may be a little bit harder

key_points.point: AI courses range from introductory courses for staying in a current job role to transformative courses for pivoting to a different company, job role or career path.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: an AI course can be something introductory which someone needs in order to remain in their current job role and increase their productivity and efficiency, all the way through to a transformative course where they are pivoting to a different company, a different job role and a different career path

key_points.point: It will continue to study this and ensure support and training are suited to learners' aspirations and opportunities.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: we will continue to study this and find ways to make sure that the type of support that we provide, the training that is made available, is best suited to the aspirations of the individual learner but also makes possible opportunities within our landscape

left_open: A curated list of courses tailored specifically to PME needs.
Additional targeted funding or workplace-supported learning for higher-level AI courses.
Specific tracking of workplace deployment after AI courses.
supplementary: Support for PMEs taking AI courses and tracking whether trainees use their skills at work.
